reasoning: Performance optimization evaluation reveals mixed results. Strong CSS organization with centralized design tokens (gradients, statusStyles) in src/lib/styles.tsx prevents duplication effectively. Performance-aware code demonstrated through TanStack Query caching, server-side filtering/sorting/pagination, and skeleton loading states. However, critical gaps exist: images use PNG format without webp/svg optimization, no responsive image sizing with srcset, and complete absence of lazy loading (no loading='lazy' on images, no React.lazy() for components). The codebase shows architectural maturity in data management and CSS organization but lacks modern image optimization and lazy loading strategies essential for production performance.
